name: singlet_cross_species_ortholog_assignment
title: Cross-species ortholog assignment
description: Assigns orthologous gene pairs between species, labelled one-to-one, one-to-many or many-to-many, and writes orthogroups and per-gene partner indices. The default method compara_precomputed reads an exported Compara table; orthofinder runs a full all-versus-all analysis unless assign_only is set. Not for expression comparison: pair scores measure sequence-based orthology, so use cross-species.one_to_many_ortholog_harmonization for expression.

dataset.description: Dataset handle with uns/proteomes per species, or a .singlet path or URI.

species.description: Species keys in uns/proteomes to include; omit to use every species in the dataset.

method.description: Orthology route; compara_precomputed is the default and the published standard.

one_to_many_max.description: Maximum partners per gene kept in the varm index; the pair table keeps every partner.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA only for MCL and batched pair scoring.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

orthofinder.description: Options used when method is orthofinder.

mcl_inflation.description: MCL inflation for graph clustering; higher values give finer orthogroups.

assign_only.description: Add genes to existing orthogroups by the SHOOT-based assign mode, without a full all-versus-all search.

omamer.description: Options used when method is omamer.

database.description: OMAmer reference database handle; required when method is omamer.

hcop_consensus.description: Options used when method is hcop_consensus.

min_evidence.description: Number of predictors that must agree to keep a pair; required for this method.

compara_precomputed.description: Options used when method is compara_precomputed.

ensembl_release.description: Ensembl release of the exported table; must match the proteome release.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/orthology/pairs. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: pairs, types (one_to_one, one_to_many, many_to_many), orthogroups, unmatched_genes, method.

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
